{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Pincer Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of at least 5 [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] employed by [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime Lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]]. When, then, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] discovered Tarrak's [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] where she was building [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]]. Thrawn launched an [[Capture of Ali Tarrak|assault]] to put an end to her attempt to proliferate the TIE Defenders. '''Pincer Squadron''' was the first set of fighters that were engaged by [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]]. When [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] in his [[Missile Boat]] was launched only '''Pincer''' 2 and 5 were standing and soon they were shot down afterwards.
